title: Lazy Property Initialization

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Lazy Property Initialization** as part of **Advanced Properties and Class Modeling**. Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters. Use the subtopics—The lazy Delegate, Lazy Initialization Modes, Initialization Timing and Thread Safety—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
